name: Emperador Inc.
summary: Emperador Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, bottling, and distributing distilled spirits and other alcoholic beverages worldwide. The company operates in two segments, the Brandy and Scotch Whisky. It offers single malt and blended scotch whiskies, liqueurs, and vodkas under The Dalmore, Jura, Tamnavulin, Fettercairn, Whyte and Mackay Blended Scotch Whisky, Woodsman Blended Scotch Whisky, Shackleton, Glayva, Invergordon, John Barr, Cluny, and Claymore brands.
